title: 第八章 你真是病得不轻
slug: 和情敌共感后傲娇竹马火葬场了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“没什么，就是觉得大半夜的，女孩子一个人回家不安全。”许卿却只是含糊其辞地重新转过了身，开始整理操作台上的文件。

俨然一副“当我什么也没说”的样子。

薄璟琛眯了眯眸，若有所思地睨了他两秒后，才推门而出。

夏暮还靠在走廊的墙上，低头看手机。

听到门响，她抬起头，把手机锁屏，站直了身子。

“怎么样了？”

“暂时死不了。”薄璟琛把手上装着片子的袋子，自然地递到她的手上。

视线随意落在她被衣领遮盖，只浅浅露出半截的纤长脖颈上，又很快挪开。

语气淡淡的，“走吧，我送你回去。”

夏暮刚想说不需要。

重新抬眼时，看见的，却只有男人离去的背影......

她唇瓣轻抿，看了看手机上显示的时间，无奈地叹了口气，抬步跟了上去。

司机已经在停车场等着了。

黑色宾利，车牌号六个8。

和薄璟琛一样，行事高调乖张。

眼睁睁看着男人坐上了汽车后座，她绕了一圈，想坐到副驾驶。

拉了两下，车门却被反锁着。

她咬了咬后槽牙，走向后排，

车子驶出医院停车场，街灯一道一道，从车窗上掠过。

全程，夏暮都靠着车门，脸转向窗外，只留给他一个后脑勺。

本以为他们会跟往日一样，彼此相顾无言一路。

谁知道，后脑处那股被凝视的感觉，愈发强烈......

不回头，她也能觉察到，他朝她凑近了。

车厢内，若有若无的苦橘香气弥漫。

薄璟琛倏而意识到，这和刚才幻觉里的味道一模一样。

他愣了一下，下意识又靠近了一点。

夏暮几乎是本能地转头，往后一缩。

Page (1/3)

"It's nothing, I just think it's not safe for a girl to go home alone in the middle of the night." Xu Qing just turned around vaguely and started sorting the documents on the console.

It's like "pretend I didn't say anything".

Bo Jingchen narrowed her eyes and stared at him thoughtfully for two seconds before pushing the door open and walking out.

Xia Mu was still leaning against the wall in the corridor, looking down at her phone.

When she heard the door knock, she raised her head, locked the screen of her phone, and stood up straight.

"How's it going?"

"I won't die for the time being." Bo Jingchen handed the bag containing the films to her hand naturally.

His eyes casually fell on her slender neck, which was covered by the collar, with only half of it exposed, and then quickly moved away.

He said calmly, "Let's go, I'll take you back."

Xia Mu was about to say no need.

When he raised his eyes again, all he saw was the man's leaving figure...

She pursed her lips lightly, looked at the time displayed on her phone, sighed helplessly, and followed her.

The driver is already waiting in the parking lot.

Black Bentley, license plate number six and eight.

Like Bo Jingchen, he behaves in a high-profile and eccentric manner.

Watching the man get into the back seat of the car, she circled around to get into the passenger seat.

After pulling twice, the car door was locked.

She gritted her molar teeth and walked to the back row.

As the car drove out of the hospital parking lot, street lights passed by the car windows one after another.

The whole time, Xia Mu leaned against the car door, her face turned towards the window, leaving only the back of his head.

I thought they would be like before, caring for each other and saying nothing all the way.

Who knows, the feeling of being stared at in the back of my head will become stronger...

Even without looking back, she could sense that he was moving closer to her.

In the carriage, the aroma of bitter orange filled the air.

Bo Jingchen suddenly realized that this smell was exactly the same as in the hallucination just now.

He was stunned for a moment, then subconsciously moved closer.

Xia Mu turned her head almost instinctively and shrank back.
